line.en: champions league, matchday 4, kick-off 20:00 uk time. the stadium is a long way out, so take the tram early; check ticket availability on the club's site.
line.de: champions league, spieltag 4, anpfiff 20:00 britische zeit. das stadion liegt außerhalb, also früh mit der tram anreisen; tickets und verfügbarkeit auf der seite des clubs prüfen.
line.tr: şampiyonlar ligi, 4. hafta, başlama saati ingiltere saatiyle 20:00. stadyum merkezden uzak, tramvayla erken gidin; biletleri ve durumu kulübün sitesinden kontrol edin.

sparks.why: Man Utd v AS Roma, Champions League matchday 4, Old Trafford, Tue 3 Nov; the 20:00 UK time is converted from a Paramount+ preview (3 PM ET), and the date also appears on sportbusy and Bundesliga listings. No official kick-off page could be opened.
